EmailTemplate.subject: Is team spirit in your blood? Prove it.
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear <Sponsor Name>,
This fall, you can help fight against blood shortage by participating in the largest blood donation competition of our lifetime.
Your school can join this challenge by scheduling your American Red Cross blood drive to participate in “The We Give Blood Drive,” sponsored by Abbott and the Big Ten Conference®. Tap into the love and competitiveness of college football and energize fans to donate blood to support their school. We’re calling on all students, alumni and fans to show their school spirit by donating at your school’s Red Cross blood drive. Help rebuild the nation’s blood supply by pitting school against school in a conference-wide blood donation competition.
“The We Give Blood Drive” runs from September 26 – December 6, 2024. Donors at your campus blood drive will have a chance to win tickets to the 2024 Discover® Big Ten® Football Championship Game on December 7, 2024, while also helping your school have a chance to win $1 million to advance student or community health.*
Joining this challenge can be done in these easy steps: 1. Contact <Red Cross Representative Name> today at <phone/email> today to schedule your campus blood drive 2. Donors visit redcrossblood.org/give to schedule their Red Cross blood donation appointment 3. Donors submit their donation on behalf of your school at www.bigten.org/abbott/submit
For more information, visit www.bigten.org/abbott.
*This offer and any resulting prize during the competition are non-transferable and not redeemable for cash. Visit https://bigten.votigo.com/fbsweeps/pages/BigTenWeGiveBloodSweepstakes/rules for the terms and conditions of the sweepstakes.
The American Red Cross is not a sponsor of the sweepstakes and is not responsible for the creation, execution or fulfillment of the We Give Blood Drive, or any aspect of the prize. This communication does not constitute an endorsement, express or implied, of any product, service, company, opinion or political position.
